statement: Start producing thread ASAP on all characters for XP; it is fast to make and strong for XP
Use thread on every character, especially ones not producing anything else; clicking button again stacks production 2x or 3x with upgrades (Infinity Hammer, Hammer bubble)
Unlock Mr Piggy Bank at level 14; get each stamp to about level 10-20 as early as possible
Accuracy and defense stamps (from W1 shop or similar) are best to level during early game
Level 22 unlocks statues via sculpting tools from the shop; deposit all statues on your primary character
Depositing statues on main matters less once you reach World 2 and unlock golden statues
Stamps and statues are cheap investments with significant bonuses and critical for early game progress
Party dungeons are best friends; unlock in frogs map at bottom; incredibly strong early to mid progression tool
Flurbo shop bonuses (accuracy %
column12: talent points for all tabs incl. star tabs) should be first priority

statement: Buy elk twist rings for 20 flurbos each early; each gives 7 defense and 2 upgrade slots; replace later with upgrade rings
Super Source star talent increases base skill efficiency and is affordable
Dungeon damage star talent gives damage percent based on credits earned in party dungeons; affordable
Joining a group strong enough to beat the fourth frog unlocks achievements giving 15% total damage to all characters
Spend time to unlock the owl; find it by climbing rope at orange mushrooms map leading to Orion
Owl is an idle game within an idle game functioning as its own entity
Grinding owl gives early buffs: all stat for damage and accuracy; base damage and damage percent; drop rate which is hard to get early
Owl also gives skill and class XP percentage bonuses
Don't spend too much time grinding owl but it is worth the effort
Unlock the portal at Bored Beans despite its decent kill count requirement
Walking sticks is one of the best early XP and money grinds; portal on right of slimes map leads into giant tree
Walking sticks base mob material is not used much; sell to shop NPC for quick cash
Walking sticks drop the bullseye statue giving accuracy percentage bonus
Walking sticks drop wood circles used in many crafting recipes including the Amarok helmet
Can farm walking sticks easily until around level 50
Need about 225 accuracy to hit 100% there; manageable by the time you beat the first boss
Joining a guild is very beneficial whether growing or max level; you gain all guild bonuses earned via guild points
Guild bonuses include drop rate; skill efficiency; carry capacity; weapon power; AFK gain; stats; card drop chance
Be social and look for a maxed guild or join a smaller one to help it grow and contribute; IBA and KNX gaming guilds recruiting
Boss quests at end of W1 give one boss key daily per character after completing first dog bone quest
Quest giver at end of W1 has two quests giving a few keys; completing first dog bone quest starts daily key per character
Boss farming becomes increasingly important so prepare early
Achievement for holding one stack of 200000 platinum unlocks collecting boss keys from quick menu; more feasible later so don't stress early
Use Amarok gear on characters as soon as possible; one of best armor sets
Amarok gear stays effective until late World 4 with plenty of stats and defense
Still need party dungeons and leveling stamps and alchemy bubbles for Amarok gear to be sufficient
Amarok helmet isn't worth making; use an iron or better helmet instead
Gather materials to craft Amarok gear for a few characters
Beyond crafting Amarok gear and upgrading weapons don't spend excessive time mining and chopping early; materials get easier later
Balance between skilling and killing is key
Recraft Amarok gear each world to apply new upgrade stones then hand older gear down to other characters
Goblet of Hemoglobin star talent unlocked by spending merit points at taskboard will carry you far
Each purchase raises max level by 5; at level 50 heals 2.59% max HP per monster kill
Hemoglobin works offline and scales with HP; HP potions make it more effective
Naked knuckle boxer task is an easy way to earn merit points to buy the star talent
Make two of each base class to take full advantage of benefits
Making a warrior first and pushing with it is fastest way through the worlds; warrior gets faster in later worlds
Each class has skilling benefits and specializes in farming monsters later in game
Name characters beginning with P or S because quest series requires typing something with them; lets you complete it yourself or help friends
Collect companions every week; free weekly RNG roll unlocks a companion with massive account-wide bonuses
Sheepy companion is a game changer
Unlock as many star signs as you can while exploring maps; bonuses grow in significance later
